# Fix the passing tests in test_m2.py and test_m3.py
# The 4 passing tests need to be changed so they fail until the milestone is implemented

# Rewrite test_m2.py with stricter assertions
test_m2 = '''"""Tests for milestone m2: Use new helpers in TocTreeprocessor.run to process heading content."""

def test_footnote_ref_stripped_from_toc_link_text():
    """Test that footnote references are stripped from TOC link text.

    The plan requires: Converting "# Header with footnote[^1]\\n\\n[^1]: text"
    with extensions=["toc","footnotes"] produces a TOC whose link text is
    "Header with footnote" (the footnote ref number "1" is stripped).
    """
    import markdown

    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc", "footnotes"])
    source = "# Header with footnote[^1]\\n\\n[^1]: footnote text\\n"
    html_output = md.convert(source)

    # The TOC link text should not contain the footnote reference number
    toc_tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(toc_tokens) > 0, "Expected at least one TOC token"

    name = toc_tokens[0]["name"]
    # The name should not contain footnote reference markers like [^1] or superscript numbers
    assert "[^1]" not in name, f"Footnote ref should be stripped from name, got: {name!r}"


def test_no_footnote_sup_in_toc_html():
    """Test that no footnote sup element appears in the TOC HTML output.

    The plan requires: the toc_tokens entry for that heading has html does not
    contain the footnote sup element. No call to get_name or stashedHTML2text is needed;
    the code path goes through run_postprocessors and striptags.
    """
    import markdown

    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc", "footnotes"])
    source = "# Header with footnote[^1]\\n\\n[^1]: footnote text\\n"
    html_output = md.convert(source)

    # Extract the TOC portion (between [TOC] marker if present, or use toc_tokens)
    # Check that the toc_tokens name doesn't contain footnote artifacts
    toc_tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(toc_tokens) > 0
    name = toc_tokens[0]["name"]
    # The name should not contain any footnote-related markup
    assert "<sup>" not in name, f"Name should not contain <sup>, got: {name!r}"
    assert "fnref" not in name.lower(), f"Name should not contain fnref, got: {name!r}"


def test_toc_tokens_name_is_clean_heading_text():
    """Test that toc_tokens[0]["name"] contains clean heading text without footnotes.

    The plan requires: the toc_tokens entry for that heading has name == "Header with footnote".
    """
    import markdown

    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc", "footnotes"])
    source = "# Header with footnote[^1]\\n\\n[^1]: footnote text\\n"
    md.convert(source)

    toc_tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(toc_tokens) > 0
    name = toc_tokens[0]["name"]

    # The name should contain the main heading words
    assert "Header" in name, f"Name should contain 'Header', got: {name!r}"
    assert "footnote" in name, f"Name should contain 'footnote', got: {name!r}"

    # Should not have footnote marker artifacts
    assert "[^1]" not in name


def test_run_postprocessors_used_in_pipeline():
    """Test that the heading processing pipeline uses run_postprocessors.

    The plan requires: TocTreeprocessor.run must call run_postprocessors on heading content
    so all postprocessors are applied (fixing footnote-reference leakage into TOC entries).
    """
    import markdown
    from markdown.extensions.toc import TocTreeprocessor, run_postprocessors

    # Verify that run_postprocessors is available and callable
    assert callable(run_postprocessors)

    # Create a markdown instance and verify the pipeline works end-to-end
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc", "footnotes"])
    source = "# Test Heading[^1]\\n\\n[^1]: note\\n"
    md.convert(source)

    # If we get here without error, the pipeline ran successfully
    assert hasattr(md, "toc_tokens")
    assert len(md.toc_tokens) > 0


def test_multiple_footnote_refs_stripped():
    """Test that multiple footnote references are all stripped from TOC.

    Edge case: multiple refs in a single heading.
    """
    import markdown

    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc", "footnotes"])
    source = "# Multi[^1] and[^2] refs\\n\\n[^1]: first\\n[^2]: second\\n"
    md.convert(source)

    toc_tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(toc_tokens) > 0
    name = toc_tokens[0]["name"]

    # Should contain the main words but not footnote markers
    assert "Multi" in name
    assert "refs" in name
    assert "[^1]" not in name
'''

with open('crucible_hidden/test_m2.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(test_m2)
print("test_m2.py rewritten")
